name: Marmosket
summary: Step into the world of Marmosket, where you play as a nimble monkey using only your hands to climb, jump, and explore. Forget about walking it's all about swinging and leaping through the mysterious landscapes of this vibrant world. Whether you're scaling trees or racing through hidden caves, there's always something new to discover. Visit the in-game shop to deck out your monkey with fun items like a wand, or even a banana.
